activityHubJournal.title: Activity journal
activityHubJournal.subtitle: Explore fictional events, their origins and the items that need your attention.
activityHubJournal.metricCopy: One row per distinct item, showing its latest event within the selected period. Multiple events for the same item count only once.
activityHubJournal.loadingCopy: Simulation: activities are loading. The event count remains unknown.
activityHubJournal.unavailableCopy: Simulation: the activity source is unavailable. No event count can be determined for this snapshot.
activityHubJournal.mediaUnavailableCopy: Simulation: the media source is unavailable. The activity count for this type remains unknown.
activityHubJournal.partialNote: Simulation: the media source is unavailable. The list and count cover only the other available sources.
activityHubJournal.partialEmptyTitle: No result among the available sources
activityHubJournal.partialEmptyCopy: Media data is missing from this snapshot. These filters return no events from the other sources; the journal remains incomplete.
activityHubJournal.demo: Local demonstration · Snapshot of October 28, 2026 at 14:30 Toronto time. No real event or change.
activityHubJournal.searchHint: A file, an event, an author…
activityHubJournal.emptyCopy: Change the period, remove a filter or try a different keyword.

readyBoreal.title: The Atelier Boréal file is ready for review
readyBoreal.summary: The demonstration materials have been gathered; human review is still required.
readyBoreal.detail:
A fictional member of the review team gathered the content of the Atelier Boréal file. This event illustrates moving to a checking stage; it expresses no approval.

Open the demonstration file to explore its content, media and permissions. No real administrative data has changed.

mediaBoreal.title: Atelier Boréal’s media needs a check
mediaBoreal.summary: A fictional automated check flags a permission question to review.
mediaBoreal.detail:
Media item DEMO-MEDIA-BOREAL-01 also appears in an October 27 event. It is the same item: the media count includes it only once and shows its latest state here.

The automatic flag is a local example. It validates neither consent, eligibility nor publication. A responsible person must examine permissions before any real use.

rulesMedia.title: A media rule reference has been updated
rulesMedia.summary: The scenario illustrates the link between media and its file’s permissions.
rulesMedia.detail:
This row describes a fictional change to rule DEMO-REGLE-MEDIA-01 in the Collectif Rivages file. It helps explore the context of an automated intervention.

The prototype changes no platform rule. An applicable rule never replaces checking media eligibility and permission for its exact use.

preparationRivages.title: The Collectif Rivages preparation is ready to read
preparationRivages.summary: A fictional draft has been prepared for human review, without approval or delivery.
preparationRivages.detail:
A demonstration team member organized the information in DEMO-PREPARATION-RIVAGES-01. This signpost only indicates that a draft can be reviewed.

Preparation, review, consent and publication authorization remain separate. Opening this detail or consulting the guide grants no permission and triggers no delivery.

readyRivages.title: The Collectif Rivages file was gathered for review
readyRivages.summary: A fictional human intervention prepared the file’s materials.
readyRivages.detail:
This October 27 event completes the demonstration journal. File DEMO-DOSSIER-RIVAGES is counted once among the week’s files.

The file link opens the local Service Delivery journey. It neither reads nor changes a real administrative file.

mediaBorealEarlier.title: First reading of Atelier Boréal’s media
mediaBorealEarlier.summary: A fictional person examined this media on October 27, before the following day’s flag.
mediaBorealEarlier.detail:
The journal retains this earlier event and the October 28 flag for the same media item DEMO-MEDIA-BOREAL-01. The journal shows both events; the media count includes only one item.

This first reading does not authorize publication. A change to content or context requires checking the applicable conditions again.

mediaRivages.title: Collectif Rivages media was examined in the scenario
mediaRivages.summary: The fictional process reports no additional issue for this item.
mediaRivages.detail:
DEMO-MEDIA-RIVAGES-01 represents a second distinct media item in the week’s examples. Its result illustrates an automated check without a flag.

The absence of a flag in this fixture proves no real compliance and does not authorize publication.

rulesConsent.title: A consent reference still needs checking
rulesConsent.summary: A fictional person noted a scope question in the Studio Canopée file.
rulesConsent.detail:
Scenario DEMO-REGLE-CONSENTEMENT-02 retains a question to examine about content usage conditions. It changes no consent.

File permissions, media eligibility and publication authorization must be checked separately in the appropriate real workflow.

mediaCanopee.title: Studio Canopée media has been reviewed
mediaCanopee.summary: A fictional human reading completes the early-week examples.
mediaCanopee.detail:
Media item DEMO-MEDIA-CANOPEE-01 is distinct from the Boréal and Rivages media. Its October 26 event belongs to the demonstration week.

This illustrated reading changes no server status, consent or visibility. All data remains synthetic.

readyCanopee.title: The Studio Canopée file is awaiting review
readyCanopee.summary: The scenario gathers the materials to check before any decision.
readyCanopee.detail:
DEMO-DOSSIER-CANOPEE represents the third distinct file ready for review in the illustrated week. The signpost invites readers to consult its context.

It validates neither payment, consent nor administrative approval. Opening this event prepares or executes no publication.

preparationBorealEarlier.title: An earlier Atelier Boréal preparation appears in the history
preparationBorealEarlier.summary: Dated October 23, this example appears in the full history and falls outside the current week.
preparationBorealEarlier.detail:
DEMO-PREPARATION-BOREAL-01 helps distinguish period boundaries. Its event predates October 26, so it contributes to none of the displayed weekly counts.

This past preparation is fictional. It represents neither an earlier approval, a delivery nor evidence of completion.

mediaCanopeeRefresh.title: New Studio Canopée media needs a reading
mediaCanopeeRefresh.summary: The local update adds a distinct media item at 14:30 in the demonstration snapshot.
mediaCanopeeRefresh.detail:
The simulated update adds DEMO-MEDIA-CANOPEE-02 only once during the visit. This new item increases the weekly media count by one.

The prototype contacts no provider and processes no file. The flag and its time are prepared in fixtures, with no real event.
